name: Aka (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow vertical stripes of red and yellow at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Aka (a red and blue shield with a bunch of grapes, a lily and ears of grain) above a yellow scroll inscribed AKA.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
